args.description: walks forward to the right in side profile: the back leg steps past the front leg, then the other, the body and head stay turned to the right like the first frame, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged held exactly as in the first frame, a seamless two-step walk cycle that ends exactly on the first pose. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
